systems.owner: Burkina Faso authorities, who decided to keep it; a first batch of equipment given by the SIPAO programme (INTERPOL, European Union funding)
systems.tiers: extended further by the donated equipment, places not stated; what it records is not described
planned for Burkina Faso in the days after August 2019, following signature of the memorandum of understanding

note: INTERPOL's SIPAO newsletter no. 12, August 2019, French edition. For Burkina Faso it says only that a first batch of donated equipment extended the national system IRAPOL, which the authorities chose to keep, that the memorandum of understanding is signed and I-24/7 connection is to follow, and that its national contact point visited the Niger centre on 11-12 June 2019. It does not say what IRAPOL does or that stations enter cases in it, so the system is unclassified and gives no fact.
